title: SiteFlow vs Procore | Construction Software Comparison
metaTitle: SiteFlow vs Procore | Construction Software Comparison
metaDescription: Compare SiteFlow vs Procore on execution visibility, BOQ-linked billing, site adoption, and cost control to choose the right construction platform.
author: SiteFlow Operations Team
body: Procore is a common first choice for construction companies, structuring workflows around documentation, coordination, and formal project controls. SiteFlow focuses on what happens on site every day, linking work done to progress tracking, billing, and cost views without heavy ERP dependency. SiteFlow fits teams wanting practical execution control; Procore suits compliance-heavy enterprises needing layered governance and integrations.

hero.headline: SiteFlow vs Procore: Construction Software Comparison
hero.subhead: Procore structures work around documentation, coordination, and formal controls. SiteFlow captures execution as it happens on site and turns it directly into visibility, billing readiness, and cost control.

faqs.q: How does SiteFlow handle BOQ and scope management compared to Procore?
faqs.a: SiteFlow captures execution as it happens on site and uses that data to drive visibility, billing readiness, and cost control, with updates tied to BOQ items. Procore structures workflows around documentation, coordination, and formal controls, often consolidating data through office processes before leadership sees the full picture.

faqs.q: Is SiteFlow a good alternative to Procore?
faqs.a: SiteFlow works as a strong alternative for teams wanting faster site adoption and clearer execution visibility, linking work done directly to progress, billing, and cost views. Procore suits compliance-heavy organisations but is heavier to configure and slower to reflect site reality.

faqs.q: Which tracks actual site progress more accurately?
faqs.a: SiteFlow ties updates to BOQ items or installed quantities and reflects them immediately in reports and billing readiness. Procore tracks progress through production quantities and pay applications that often need structured review before consolidated insights appear.

faqs.q: Should I choose SiteFlow or Procore?
faqs.a: Choose SiteFlow for execution-driven control, BOQ-based tracking, fast site adoption, and real-time cost visibility without heavy ERP dependency. Choose Procore if your projects require enterprise governance, compliance, and extensive integrations.
